items.title: Elon Musk takes aim at Delta for refusing to use Starlink for Wi-Fi
items.summary: In a post on X this week, SpaceX (SPCX) founder and CEO Elon Musk took aim at Delta Air Lines (DAL) for not using Starlink to offer internet access on its flights. The 8:30 Hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley break down the story.

items.title: The Delta-SpaceX Feud Just Escalated. Investors Beware.
items.summary: The spat between  SpaceX  CEO Elon Musk and  Delta Air Lines  CEO Ed Bastian is escalating.  Delta passed on Starlink in the spring, opting for  Amazon.com’s  space-based broadband product, called Amazon Leo.  Delta now uses T-Mobile, with the help of Viasat, and will roll out Leo in 2028.
